dotnet-type

Cross-layer readable/writable contract for an announcement module item.

summary

Cross-layer readable/writable contract for an announcement module item.

公告模块条目的跨层只读/可写契约。

remarks

This interface passes announcement fields between legacy content-module data access and Web Forms display controls. Implementations express field semantics only; module ownership, link safety, expiry filtering, and HTML encoding are owned by callers.

该接口用于旧内容模块数据访问和 Web Forms 展示控件之间传递公告字段。实现只表达字段语义； 模块归属、链接安全、过期过滤和 HTML 编码由调用层各自负责。

Collaboration-item data-scope snapshot: server-resolved evidence of an actor's ownership, participation, and organization scope.fallback: en

summary

Collaboration-item data-scope snapshot: server-resolved evidence of an actor's ownership, participation, and organization scope.

协同事项数据范围快照：一次服务端解析得到的动作人归属、参与与组织范围证据。

remarks

This type carries only read-only evidence for the decision: it reads no database, infers no role inheritance, and caches no cross-request state. An empty organization-scope collection means "scope unknown or no organization scope at all", in which case the organization dimension must not grant visibility (fail-closed).

本类型只承载判定所需的只读证据：不读取数据库、不推断角色继承、不缓存跨请求状态。组织范围集合为空表示"范围未知或没有任何组织范围"，此时组织维度不得授予可见性（fail-closed）。

#ctor

dotnet-method

Creates a data-scope snapshot from server-resolved ownership, participation, and organization evidence.

Creates a data-scope snapshot from server-resolved ownership, participation, and organization evidence.fallback: en

Localized Fields

summary

Creates a data-scope snapshot from server-resolved ownership, participation, and organization evidence.

用服务端已解析的归属、参与和组织证据创建数据范围快照。

params.actorUserId.summary

Portal-user identifier re-resolved by the server; a non-positive value means the identity is missing and the decision denies directly.

服务端重新解析得到的门户用户标识；非正值表示身份缺失，判定会直接拒绝。

params.isAdministrator.summary

Administrator flag computed by the server from roles or the collaboration-admin permission; it only continues the existing centralized viewing capability and remains constrained by the upstream permission gate.

服务端按角色或协同管理员权限计算出的管理员标记；该标记只延续既有集中查看能力，仍受上游权限门禁约束。

params.isParticipant.summary

Whether the current user belongs to the item participant set (Collaborator or Watcher); supplied by the caller after a server-side query.

当前用户是否属于事项参与人集合（协办或关注）；由调用方在服务端查询后传入。

params.visibleOrganizationUnitIds.summary

Organization-unit identifiers visible to the current user; may be null, and an empty collection is treated as "scope unknown".

当前用户可见组织单元标识集合；可为空引用，空集合按"范围未知"处理。

params.holdsOwnerRoleKey.summary

Whether the current user holds the item's owner role key (a controlled permission key), supplied after a server-side comparison; the policy itself never touches a permission collection. Added in W72 so the read boundary aligns with the existing write eligibility.

当前用户是否持有该事项的负责人角色键（受控权限键），由服务端比较后传入；策略本身不接触权限集合。W72 新增，用于让读取边界与既有写资格对齐。

CollaborationItemDataScopePolicy

dotnet-type

Pure decision policy for collaboration-item data-scope visibility: it answers "is this row visible" only from server-resolved evidence.

Pure decision policy for collaboration-item data-scope visibility: it answers "is this row visible" only from server-resolved evidence.fallback: en

Localized Fields

summary

Pure decision policy for collaboration-item data-scope visibility: it answers "is this row visible" only from server-resolved evidence.

协同事项数据范围可见性的纯决策策略：只依据服务端已解析的证据回答"这条数据是否可见"。

remarks

This type is the single decision entry point of the P63.1 data-scope contract, shared by list and detail reads so both paths use one rule. The decision is fail-closed: missing evidence, missing identity, or insufficient scope information always denies rather than allows or returns a "partially visible" state. The policy reads no database, no configuration, and no HTTP context, so it can be verified directly in unit tests.

本类型是 P63.1 数据范围契约的唯一判定入口，供列表与详情共用，保证两条读取路径使用同一规则。判定遵循 fail-closed：证据缺失、身份缺失或范围信息不足时一律拒绝，而不是放行或返回"部分可见"。本策略不读取数据库、不解析配置、不接触 HTTP 上下文，因此可在单测中直接验证。

Source

Defined in src/Portal.Components/bin/Debug/Portal.Components.xml:1

CanView

dotnet-method

Decides whether the current actor may view the specified collaboration item through the ownership, participant, and organization dimensions.

Decides whether the current actor may view the specified collaboration item through the ownership, participant, and organization dimensions.fallback: en

Localized Fields

summary

Decides whether the current actor may view the specified collaboration item through the ownership, participant, and organization dimensions.

按归属、参与人和组织三个维度判定当前动作人是否可见指定协同事项。

remarks

The dimension order is: administrator continues the existing centralized viewing capability, then ownership (initiator or owner user), then the **owner role key** (added in W72 to align with the existing write eligibility), then the participant set, then the organization scope. The organization dimension requires the item to carry an organization-unit identifier that falls inside the visible collection; an item without an organization unit or an empty visible collection grants nothing through this dimension.

维度判定顺序为：管理员延续既有集中查看能力 → 归属（发起人或负责人用户）→ **负责人角色键**（W72 新增，与既有写资格对齐）→ 参与人集合 → 组织范围。组织维度要求事项组织单元标识存在且落在可见集合内；事项未标注组织或可见集合为空时该维度不授予可见性。

params.item.summary

Collaboration-item projection to evaluate; a null reference fails the decision.

待判定的协同事项投影；为空引用时判定失败。

params.scope.summary

Server-resolved data-scope snapshot of the current actor; a null reference fails the decision.

服务端解析出的当前动作人数据范围快照；为空引用时判定失败。

returns.summary

when any dimension holds;when evidence is insufficient or all dimensions fail, without distinguishing "does not exist" from "not authorized". true false

任一维度成立时为；证据不足或全部维度不成立时为，且不区分"不存在"与"无权访问"。 true false

EmployeeProfileConfirmationRequest

dotnet-type

Write request for confirming an employee profile.

Write request for confirming an employee profile.fallback: en

Localized Fields

summary

Write request for confirming an employee profile.

员工资料确认写入请求。

remarks

Callers must resolve the Portal user id and employee id from the current sign-in context before creating this request. This request carries no password, cookie, token, or authentication-ticket content. The data layer rechecks the active user-to-employee binding so a stale employee id from the page is not trusted.

调用方必须先基于当前登录账号解析出门户用户标识和员工标识；本请求不承载密码、Cookie、Token 或任何身份票据内容。数据层会再次确认该用户与员工之间存在当前有效绑定，避免页面层传入过期员工标识。

Source

Stable status values for employee-profile correction requests.

remarks

These strings are written to correction tables, admin filters, audit events, and work-item summaries, so they are a persistence contract; adding or renaming statuses must be synchronized with database scripts, admin pages, audit documentation, and acceptance checks. This class expresses only the portal's current minimal status flow and does not replace a full workflow engine.

这些字符串会进入资料更正表、后台筛选、审计事件和工作项摘要，属于持久化契约；新增或改名状态时必须同步数据库脚本、后台页面、审计说明和验收清单。本类只表达门户当前的最小状态流，不替代完整工作流引擎。

GetOrganizationUnitSubtreeIds

dotnet-method

Reads the identifier set of the organization subtree rooted at the specified unit (root included), so a directory query can be bounded to an organization scope.

Reads the identifier set of the organization subtree rooted at the specified unit (root included), so a directory query can be bounded to an organization scope.fallback: en

Localized Fields

summary

Reads the identifier set of the organization subtree rooted at the specified unit (root included), so a directory query can be bounded to an organization scope.

读取以指定组织为根的子树组织单元标识集合（含根节点），用于把目录查询圈定在组织范围内。

remarks

Added in W68: existing directory queries filter only by keyword and status and cannot express "one organization and its descendants". This method supplies the subtree identifiers for organization-scoped filtering and for the later W63 visibility extension. The contract is fail-closed: a non-positive, missing, or unreadable root, as well as schema or read failures, all yield an empty set instead of a full scan. Callers must still authorize; the identifier set itself grants no access.

W68 新增：既有目录查询只能按关键字与状态过滤，无法表达"某组织及其后代"。本方法提供子树标识，供组织范围过滤与后续可见性扩展复用。契约按 fail-closed 处理：根节点非正值、不存在、架构不可用或读取失败一律返回空集合，不退化为全量；调用方仍须自行完成授权，标识集合本身不授予任何访问权。 W63

params.organizationUnitId.summary

The subtree root organization unit identifier; a non-positive value yields an empty set.

子树根组织单元标识；非正值返回空集合。

returns.summary

The subtree organization unit identifier list (root included); empty on failure.

子树组织单元标识列表（含根节点）；失败时为空列表。

Source

ResubmitApplication

dotnet-method

Lets the applicant resubmit a returned business application, sending it back into the review window.

Lets the applicant resubmit a returned business application, sending it back into the review window.fallback: en

Localized Fields

summary

Lets the applicant resubmit a returned business application, sending it back into the review window.

申请人重提被退回的业务申请，把它送回待审核窗口。

remarks

Added in W71. This is an applicant self-service action kept apart from the review responsibility of: only the original applicant may resubmit, and only fromto. Both the ownership and status conditions live in a single UPDATE statement to prevent state drift between reading and writing (TOCTOU). An implementation must also clear the review time and reviewer columns because a table check constraint requires both to be null in thestate. The contract is fail-closed: a non-positive identifier, a missing application, an ownership mismatch, a disallowed status, or a read failure all return a failure without changing any row. Returned Submitted Submitted

W71 新增。这是**申请人自助动作**，与的审核职责分开：只有提交人本人可重提，且只从重提到；归属与状态条件都写在同一个 UPDATE 语句里，避免读取与写入之间的状态漂移（TOCTOU）。实现还必须同时清空审核时间与审核人，因为表的检查约束要求状态下这两列为空。契约按 fail-closed 处理：标识非正值、申请不存在、归属不符、状态不允许或读取失败，一律返回失败且不改变任何行。 Returned Submitted Submitted

params.applicationId.summary

The business application identifier.

业务申请标识。

params.applicantUserId.summary

The applicant's Portal user identifier; it must match the application's applicant.

提交人门户用户标识；必须与该申请的提交人一致。

params.actorName.summary

Actor account name or system identifier; implementations usewhen blank. system

操作人账号名或系统标识；空白时实现使用。 system

returns.summary

The resubmission result.

重提结果。

Source

GetVisibleEventsForItems

dotnet-method

Reads the timelines of several items visible to the current user in one batch, removing the N+1 queries caused by per-row reads in a list.

Reads the timelines of several items visible to the current user in one batch, removing the N+1 queries caused by per-row reads in a list.fallback: en

Localized Fields

summary

Reads the timelines of several items visible to the current user in one batch, removing the N+1 queries caused by per-row reads in a list.

批量读取多个事项对当前用户可见的时间线，用于消除列表逐行读取造成的 N+1 查询。

remarks

Semantically equivalent to the per-item: actor authorization is computed once, yetandare still evaluated **for every item individually** (a security constraint that must not be collapsed for performance). Items that are unauthorized or missing appear as empty lists so callers never distinguish internal states. The returned dictionary **contains every requested identifier** (empty list when no events exist) and preserves the per-item ordering of the single-item read. Empty input, unavailable schema, or read failure yields all-empty lists. CanParticipate CanView

语义与逐条等价：动作人授权只计算一次，但**每个事项仍逐个执行与校验**（安全约束不得为性能合并掉）；未被授权或不存在的事项在结果中为空列表，使调用方无需区分内部状态。返回的字典**包含全部请求标识**（无事件者为空列表），条目内顺序与逐条读取一致。空输入、schema 不可用或读取失败时返回全部为空列表的结果。 CanParticipate CanView

params.itemIds.summary

Item identifiers to read, possibly; non-positive and duplicate entries are discarded, and entries beyond the implementation cap are truncated. null

待读取的事项标识集合，可为；非正数与重复项被丢弃，超出实现上限的部分被截断。 null

params.actorUserId.summary

Current actor user identifier; an invalid value yields all-empty lists.

当前动作人用户标识；无效时全部返回空列表。

returns.summary

Visible events keyed by item identifier.

以事项标识为键的可见事件集合。

CancelOwnRequest

dotnet-method

Withdraws a still-pending correction request submitted by the requesting user.

Withdraws a still-pending correction request submitted by the requesting user.fallback: en

Localized Fields

summary

Withdraws a still-pending correction request submitted by the requesting user.

撤回本人提出的、尚在处理中的更正请求。

remarks

Added in W69. Because the request table constrains status values, withdrawal reuses, records the requester as the actor, and leaves a note; no new status and no migration are needed. The contract is fail-closed: a non-positive user or request identifier, a missing request, an ownership mismatch, a status that is no longer pending, and any runtime failure all return a failure without changing any row. Failure explanations stay low-sensitivity and never echo another user's request details. Closed

W69 新增。请求表状态受检查约束限定，因此撤回复用并把提交人记为操作人、在备注留痕，不引入新状态也不需要迁移。契约按 fail-closed 处理：用户标识或请求标识非正值、请求不存在、归属不符、状态已不是处理中，以及任何运行失败，都返回失败且不改变任何行；失败说明保持低敏，不回显他人请求细节。 Closed

params.userId.summary

The current Portal user identifier.

当前门户用户标识。

params.requestId.summary

The correction request identifier.

更正请求标识。

params.actorName.summary

Actor account name or system identifier; implementations usewhen blank. system

操作人账号名或系统标识；空白时实现使用。 system

returns.summary

The withdrawal result.

撤回结果。

summary

Data-access contract for the lightweight approval/work-item foundation.

轻量审批/待办基础的数据访问契约。

remarks

The first P12.3 version only projects business objects into minimal work-item records; it does not implement BPM, delegation, co-signing, or external notifications. This facade validates neither business-object authorization nor an atomic boundary with the caller's domain transaction. Callers must authorize and persist the domain action first, then treat work-item failures as degradation of supplemental capability.

The reuse path does not promise to refresh an existing title, summary, assignment, or due time. Callers should inspectand must not treat its display message as authorization or an idempotency token.

A low-sensitivity result containing the reused or newly created work-item identifier on success, or a failure for validation, schema, or runtime errors.

GetWorkItemsForUser

dotnet-method

Reads a snapshot of work items assigned to the specified user or to role keys the user holds, for the front-end "My To-Do Items" aggregation entry.

Reads a snapshot of work items assigned to the specified user or to role keys the user holds, for the front-end "My To-Do Items" aggregation entry.fallback: en

Localized Fields

summary

Reads a snapshot of work items assigned to the specified user or to role keys the user holds, for the front-end "My To-Do Items" aggregation entry.

读取指派给指定用户或其持有角色键的待办快照，用于前台"我的待办"聚合入口。

remarks

A row matches when the assigned user identifier equals the current user, or when the assigned role key falls inside the supplied controlled key set. This contract does not resolve role membership: the caller must resolve the key set with existing authorization capability and pass it in, so the data layer never infers ownership beyond its authority. When the supplied user identifier is non-positive and the key set is empty, the method fails closed and returns a successful but empty result instead of degrading to an unrestricted query. The result explicitly separates "succeeded with no matches" from "read failure" so a front end can render empty and failure states separately.

命中条件为"指派用户标识等于当前用户"或"指派角色键落在传入的受控键集合内"。本契约不解析角色成员关系：键集合必须由调用方用既有授权能力解析后传入，避免数据层越权推导归属。传入的用户标识非正数且键集合为空时按 fail-closed 返回成功但空的结果，不退化成全量查询。结果显式区分"成功且无命中"与"读取失败"，供前台分别呈现空态与失败态。

params.userId.summary

The current Portal user identifier. A non-positive value disables matching by user identifier, leaving role-key matching only.

当前门户用户标识；非正数表示不按用户标识命中，此时仅按角色键命中。

params.assignedRoleKeys.summary

The controlled role or permission keys held by the current user. It may be null or empty. Blank entries are discarded, duplicates are merged, and entries beyond the implementation cap are truncated.

当前用户持有的受控角色或权限键集合；可为空引用或空集合。空白项被丢弃，重复项被合并，数量超出实现上限的部分被截断。

params.status.summary

Exact status filter; blank means unfinished items only (). The current implementation only trims the text and does not validate it againstconstants.

精确状态筛选；空白表示仅未完成（）。当前实现只裁剪文本，不校验是否为常量。

params.take.summary

Requested maximum row count; the current implementation uses 50 for non-positive values and caps the count at 200.

期望最大条数；当前实现对非正数使用 50，并把上限限制为 200。

returns.summary

A query result carrying the success flag and the newest-first work-item projections; unavailable schema or query failures yield a failed result with an empty list.

包含成功标记与最新优先待办投影的查询结果；架构不可用或查询异常时返回失败结果且列表为空。

Source

Defined in src/Portal.Components/bin/Debug/Portal.Components.xml:1

IsProtectedAdministrationTabName

dotnet-method

Decides whether a Tab is the protected core administration Tab by its **navigation stable key** (preferred) or display name (fallback).

Decides whether a Tab is the protected core administration Tab by its **navigation stable key** (preferred) or display name (fallback).fallback: en

Localized Fields

summary

Decides whether a Tab is the protected core administration Tab by its **navigation stable key** (preferred) or display name (fallback).

按**导航稳定键**（优先）或显示名称（回退）判断 Tab 是否为受保护的核心后台 Tab。

remarks

Why a stable key is required: tab names (`TabName`) are now multilingual, so the display name changes with the UI culture and can even be renamed to Chinese by an administrator, while "administration entry protection", "rename blocked", and "keep the administration Tab last" all recognize by name. If recognition stayed on the display name, the moment `Admin` became "后台管理" the protection would silently stop working — the most dangerous knock-on effect of localizing tab names. Migration `PortalCfg_TabModuleMultilingualNames.sql` backfills existing tab names as stable keys, so existing deployments regress not at all.

为什么必须引入稳定键：页签名（`TabName`）已支持多语言，显示名会随界面文化改变甚至被管理员改成中文， 而"后台入口保护""禁止重命名""后台 Tab 排到最后"这些策略都按名识别。若继续按显示名判定， 把 Admin 改成"后台管理"的那一刻，保护就会静默失效 —— 这正是页签名本地化最危险的连带破坏点。 迁移脚本 `PortalCfg_TabModuleMultilingualNames.sql` 已把既有页签名回填为稳定键，因此存量部署零回归。

PortalDisplayNameResolver

dotnet-type

Resolves database-carried display names (Chinese column / English column / other-languages JSON column) by UI culture.

Resolves database-carried display names (Chinese column / English column / other-languages JSON column) by UI culture.fallback: en

Localized Fields

summary

Resolves database-carried display names (Chinese column / English column / other-languages JSON column) by UI culture.

按界面文化解析数据库承载的显示名（中文列 / 英文列 / 其它语言 JSON 列）。

remarks

Reason it exists: the portal shell and module body text come from `App_GlobalResources/lang.*` resources, while tab names (`PortalCfg_Tabs.TabName`) and module titles (`PortalCfg_Modules.ModuleTitle`) are single-column database text that **does not follow the language switch**, producing "English title + Chinese body" inside one card. This resolver connects those texts to the same culture decision the resources use, which is what makes the mixing fixable. Column design (user decision, 2026-10-18): one Chinese column, one English column, and one JSON column for every other language. The Chinese side reuses the existing columns (`TabName` / `ModuleTitle`) rather than adding new ones — those columns are `NOT NULL` and are the default source of every renderer, so reusing them guarantees there is always something to display. Resolution order: 1. two-letter language code `zh` (including zh-CN / zh-TW and other regional variants) → Chinese column, falling back to the English column when missing; 2. two-letter code `en` → English column, falling back to the Chinese column when missing; 3. any other culture → three-tier JSON lookup "full culture name → parent culture name → two-letter code"; 4. no hit → Chinese column → English column → empty string. That fallback chain matches the existing `PortalNavigationEntry.GetDisplayName` semantics (Chinese cultures take the Chinese name, English cultures the English one, and a missing side falls back to the other), so two display-name resolvers cannot disagree about the same culture. Proof boundary: this type proves only that "the most suitable display text was selected for the culture". It does **not** prove the text is a correct translation, that JSON keys are supported cultures (that allowlist belongs to language administration), and it makes no authorization decision.

存在理由：门户壳层与模块正文走 `App_GlobalResources/lang.*` 资源，而页签名（`PortalCfg_Tabs.TabName`）与 模块标题（`PortalCfg_Modules.ModuleTitle`）是数据库单列文本，**不随语言切换**，于是同一张卡片里出现 "英文标题 + 中文正文"的中英混排。本解析器把这两类文本接入与资源同源的文化判定，混排才有解。 列设计（用户 2026-10-18 裁定）：中文一列、英文一列、其它所有语言合并为一个 JSON 列。 中文列复用既有列（`TabName` / `ModuleTitle`）而不是新增列 —— 既有列 `NOT NULL` 且是所有渲染点的默认来源， 复用它才能保证"永远有值可显示"。 解析顺序： 1. 两字母语言码 `zh`（含 zh-CN / zh-TW 等区域变体）→ 中文列，缺失回落英文列； 2. 两字母语言码 `en` → 英文列，缺失回落中文列； 3. 其它文化 → JSON 列按"完整文化名 → 父文化名 → 两字母码"三级匹配； 4. 三级都未命中 → 回落中文列 → 回落英文列 → 空字符串。 该回退链与既有 `PortalNavigationEntry.GetDisplayName` 的语义一致（中文文化取中文、英文文化取英文、 一侧缺失回落另一侧），避免两套显示名解析逻辑对同一文化给出不同结论。 证明边界：本类型只证明"按文化选出最合适的显示文本"，**不证明**文本本身翻译正确、 JSON 键是受支持的文化（键名白名单属于语言管理功能），也不做任何授权判断。

Source

Resolve

dotnet-method

Resolves the display name for the supplied UI culture and reports the fallback reason through `diagnostic`.

Resolves the display name for the supplied UI culture and reports the fallback reason through `diagnostic`.fallback: en

summary

Resolves the display name for the supplied UI culture and reports the fallback reason through `diagnostic`.

按指定界面文化解析显示名，并通过 `diagnostic` 输出降级原因。

remarks

This method **never throws**: a damaged JSON column, a missing culture, or all-blank candidates all follow the fallback chain. It sits on the rendering path of the portal header and module titles, so one dirty row turning the whole page into a 500 is far worse than showing fallback text; whether to raise an alarm is the caller's decision based on `diagnostic`.

本方法**不抛异常**：JSON 列损坏、文化缺失或候选全空都走回退链。理由是它处在门户页头与模块标题的 渲染路径上 —— 一条脏数据就让整页 500，比"显示回退文本"糟糕得多；是否报警由调用方凭 `diagnostic` 决定。

params.chineseText.summary

Value of the Chinese column, which is also the default fallback.

中文列兼默认回退列的值。

params.englishText.summary

Value of the English column.

英文列的值。

params.localizedJson.summary

Other-languages column: culture-keyed JSON object text, may be empty.

其它语言列；以文化名为键的 JSON 对象文本，可为空。

params.culture.summary

Target UI culture; when null the current thread UI culture is used.

目标界面文化；为空时使用当前线程界面文化。

params.diagnostic.summary

Fallback reason; an empty string on a normal hit or when no other languages exist. Callers may write it to a diagnostic log but should not show it to users.

降级原因；正常命中或无其它语言可查时为空字符串。调用方可把它写入诊断日志，不应直接显示给用户。

returns.summary

Text ready to display; an empty string when every candidate is blank.

可直接显示的文本；全部候选为空时返回空字符串。

TryGetJsonValue

dotnet-method

Retrieves the text for a culture from the other-languages JSON column using the three-tier lookup "full culture name → parent culture name → two-letter code".

Retrieves the text for a culture from the other-languages JSON column using the three-tier lookup "full culture name → parent culture name → two-letter code".fallback: en

Localized Fields

summary

Retrieves the text for a culture from the other-languages JSON column using the three-tier lookup "full culture name → parent culture name → two-letter code".

从其它语言 JSON 列中按"完整文化名 → 父文化名 → 两字母码"三级取回该文化的文本。

remarks

A parse failure always becomes "no hit plus a reason" and never throws: the JSON column is hand-edited by administrators, so arrays, nesting, or mistyped keys can occur, and all of them should degrade to the default language rather than turning the portal header into an error page. Key comparison is case-insensitive: casing differences in culture names (`ja-jp` versus `ja-JP`) must not lose the value.

解析失败一律走"未命中 + 原因"，绝不抛出：JSON 列由管理员手填，允许出现数组、嵌套或键名拼错， 这些都应表现为"回落到默认语言"，而不是把门户页头打成错误页。 键比较使用大小写不敏感：文化名的大小写差异（`ja-jp` 与 `ja-JP`）不应导致取不到值。

以文化名为键的 JSON 对象文本；空白视为"没有其它语言"，不算错误。

目标界面文化。

PortalNavigationRegistry

dotnet-type

Static registry for Portal navigation entries.

Static registry for Portal navigation entries.fallback: en

Localized Fields

summary

Static registry for Portal navigation entries.

门户导航入口静态注册表。

remarks

The registry publishes reviewable navigation metadata and visibility dependencies only; it reads no current user, module state, or deployment configuration and performs no routing or authorization. Consumers must complete actual checks independently when showing or accessing an entry.

注册表只发布可审查的导航元数据和显示依赖；它不读取当前用户、模块状态或部署配置，也不执行路由和授权。消费方必须在显示或访问入口时独立完成实际检查。

Current context required for navigation visibility decisions (pure data; it reads no HttpContext, database, or configuration).

Defined in src/Portal.Components/bin/Debug/Portal.Components.xml:1

BuildTabEntryKey

dotnet-method

Builds the stable entry key of a main-navigation Tab; the **navigation stable key takes precedence**, falling back to the Tab display name when absent.

Builds the stable entry key of a main-navigation Tab; the **navigation stable key takes precedence**, falling back to the Tab display name when absent.fallback: en

Localized Fields

summary

Builds the stable entry key of a main-navigation Tab; the **navigation stable key takes precedence**, falling back to the Tab display name when absent.

构造主导航 Tab 的稳定入口键；**导航稳定键优先**，缺失时回退到 Tab 显示名称。

remarks

Why a stable key is needed: once tab names are localized, the same tab displays differently per UI culture (`首页` / `Home`), and an administrator can rename it to anything. If the key were still derived from the display name, the registered `Tab.Home` would fail to match under the Chinese UI and the gate would silently degrade to "unregistered means allowed" — which is not a safe allow but the **vanishing of a permission check**. The migration backfills existing tab names as stable keys, so existing deployments keep their `Tab.*` keys byte-identical.

为什么需要稳定键：页签名本地化后，同一页签在不同界面文化下显示名不同（`首页` / `Home`）， 管理员还可以把它改成任意文本。若键仍由显示名派生，registry 里登记的 `Tab.Home` 会在中文界面下失配， 门控静默退化为"未登记即放行" —— 那不是安全的放行，而是**权限检查凭空消失**。 迁移脚本已把存量页签名回填为稳定键，因此存量部署的 `Tab.*` 键逐字节不变。

params.tabName.summary

Tab name from portal configuration, used as the fallback when the stable key is absent.

门户配置中的 Tab 名称，作为稳定键缺失时的回退。

params.navigationKey.summary

Navigation stable key; the Tab name is used when it is blank.

导航稳定键；为空时回退到 Tab 名称。

returns.summary

Stable entry key; empty when both the Tab name and the stable key are blank.

稳定入口键；Tab 名与稳定键均为空白时为空字符串。

Source

GetTabBlockedReason

dotnet-method

Decides whether a portal-configuration tab is blocked by the entry gate; a reason code is returned only when the tab is registered and its dependencies are unsatisfied.

Decides whether a portal-configuration tab is blocked by the entry gate; a reason code is returned only when the tab is registered and its dependencies are unsatisfied.fallback: en

Localized Fields

summary

Decides whether a portal-configuration tab is blocked by the entry gate; a reason code is returned only when the tab is registered and its dependencies are unsatisfied.

判定门户配置中的 Tab 是否被入口 gate 阻断；只有"已登记且依赖不满足"才返回原因码。

remarks

This method deliberately fails in the opposite direction from the action area: an unregistered tab, a blank name, or a missing context is always allowed. The main navigation has already been filtered by role before this call, so allowing cannot leak an over-permissioned entry, whereas losing every tab to a gate fault would turn a governance improvement into an availability incident. The blocking decision itself still reuses the shared six-step visibility evaluation rather than defining new rules.

本方法刻意采用与动作区相反的失败方向：未登记 Tab、空白名或上下文缺失一律**放行**。原因是主导航在调用本方法前已按角色过滤，放行不会泄露超权入口；反之若 gate 故障导致全部 Tab 消失，会把"治理增强"变成可用性事故。阻断判定本身仍复用统一的六步可见性判定，不另立规则。

params.tabName.summary

Tab name from portal configuration.

门户配置中的 Tab 名称。

params.context.summary

Current user and deployment state; treated as allowed when null (see remarks).

当前用户与部署状态；为 null 时按放行处理（见备注）。

returns.summary

Blocked reason code;when the tab is allowed. null

阻断原因码；放行时为。 null

Source

GetTabBlockedReason

dotnet-method

Decides whether a portal-configuration tab is blocked by the entry gate; the registry lookup uses the **navigation stable key**, falling back to the display name only when it is absent.

Decides whether a portal-configuration tab is blocked by the entry gate; the registry lookup uses the **navigation stable key**, falling back to the display name only when it is absent.fallback: en

Localized Fields

summary

Decides whether a portal-configuration tab is blocked by the entry gate; the registry lookup uses the **navigation stable key**, falling back to the display name only when it is absent.

判定门户配置中的 Tab 是否被入口 gate 阻断；阻断判定按**导航稳定键**查 registry，缺失时才回退到显示名。

remarks

This method deliberately fails in the opposite direction from the action area: an unregistered tab, a blank name, or a missing context is always allowed. The main navigation has already been filtered by role before this call, so allowing cannot leak an over-permissioned entry, whereas losing every tab to a gate fault would turn a governance improvement into an availability incident. The blocking decision itself still reuses the shared six-step visibility evaluation rather than defining new rules. This is also why the stable key must be passed: the allow-fallback is safe, but allowing *because a localized display name missed the registry* silently removes a governance rule.

本方法刻意采用与动作区相反的失败方向：未登记 Tab、空白名或上下文缺失一律**放行**。原因是主导航在调用本方法前已按角色过滤，放行不会泄露超权入口；反之若 gate 故障导致全部 Tab 消失，会把"治理增强"变成可用性事故。阻断判定本身仍复用统一的六步可见性判定，不另立规则。 这也解释了为什么必须传稳定键：放行兜底很安全，但"因为显示名本地化导致查不到登记项"而放行，等于让一条治理规则无声消失。

params.context.summary

Current user and deployment state; treated as allowed when null (see remarks).

当前用户与部署状态；为 null 时按放行处理（见备注）。

returns.summary

Blocked reason code;when the tab is allowed. null

PortalBusinessApplicationTransitions

dotnet-type

The single source of truth for the business-application state machine: action-to-target mapping, legal source statuses, and generation of the administration review SQL status predicate.

The single source of truth for the business-application state machine: action-to-target mapping, legal source statuses, and generation of the administration review SQL status predicate.fallback: en

Localized Fields

summary

The single source of truth for the business-application state machine: action-to-target mapping, legal source statuses, and generation of the administration review SQL status predicate.

业务申请状态机的**单一事实源**：动作到目标状态、合法来源状态，以及后台审核 SQL 状态谓词的生成。

remarks

Structurally identical tofor collaboration items, following the criterion established in W64. This table deliberately preserves existing semantics: the four review actions Approve / Return / Reject / Close all accept `Submitted` / `InReview`, exactly matching the hard-coded window that preceded this explicitization. Making the table explicit does not change semantics, and adjusting the legal sources of Close is a separate decision. `Resubmit` is an applicant self-service action from `Returned` to `Submitted` that deliberately stays out of the administration review predicate.

与协同事项的同构（`W64` 已建立该判据）。本表刻意**保留既有语义**：Approve / Return / Reject / Close 四个审核动作的合法来源都是 `Submitted` / `InReview`，与显式化之前的硬编码窗口完全一致；显式化不是改语义，调整 Close 的合法来源属独立决策。`Resubmit` 为申请人自助动作，来源为 `Returned`，目标为 `Submitted`，且**不进入**后台审核谓词。

Source

PortalCollaborationItemTransitions

dotnet-type

Explicit legal-transition table of the collaboration-item finite-state machine, serving as the single source of truth for status, action, and target status.

Explicit legal-transition table of the collaboration-item finite-state machine, serving as the single source of truth for status, action, and target status.fallback: en

summary

Explicit legal-transition table of the collaboration-item finite-state machine, serving as the single source of truth for status, action, and target status.

协同事项有限状态机的显式合法迁移表，作为状态/动作/目标状态的单一事实源。

remarks

This class is the core of the P64 state-machine explicitization: it collapses the two earlier fact copies—the SQL string and theif-chain—into one testable dataset. The action-to-target mapping is unique in the current design (an action always reaches the same target regardless of the source status), soandderive from this table; the SQL predicate used as the database write guard is also generated byto avoid drift. The class reads no database and depends on no HTTP context, so it can be verified directly in unit tests. MapActionToStatus MapActionToStatus

本类是 P64 状态机显式化的核心：把原先散落在 SQL 字符串与if-链中的两份事实收敛成一份可单测的数据。动作到目标状态在当前设计中唯一（即同一动作不论从哪个当前状态出发，目标相同），因此与可由本表派生；数据库写入守卫的 SQL 谓词也由生成，避免与表漂移。本类不读取数据库、不依赖 HTTP 上下文，可在单测中直接验证。 MapActionToStatus MapActionToStatus

PortalPasswordPolicy

dotnet-type

Portal password-complexity policy for the enterprise user lifecycle registration, account-creation, and password-reset entry points.

Portal password-complexity policy for the enterprise user lifecycle registration, account-creation, and password-reset entry points.fallback: en

Localized Fields

summary

Portal password-complexity policy for the enterprise user lifecycle registration, account-creation, and password-reset entry points.

门户密码复杂度策略，用于企业用户生命周期的注册、建号和重置密码入口。

remarks

The component layer keeps 8 characters / 3 categories as the hard lower bound. The Web layer may inject runtime policy options on startup so system settings can control stronger minimum length, category count, weak-password dictionary checks, and account-context-word restrictions. This type does not handle password history, failure lockout, or client-side encryption protocols.

组件层保留 8 位/3 类作为硬下限；Web 层可在启动时注入运行期策略选项，让系统管理设置 能控制更高强度的最小长度、类别数量、弱口令字典和账号上下文词限制。此类型不处理历史密码、 失败锁定或客户端加密协议。

Source

PortalPasswordIterationPolicy

dotnet-type

Decides the target PBKDF2 iteration count for strong password hashes and whether stored credentials need rehashing.

Decides the target PBKDF2 iteration count for strong password hashes and whether stored credentials need rehashing.fallback: en

Localized Fields

summary

Decides the target PBKDF2 iteration count for strong password hashes and whether stored credentials need rehashing.

裁定强密码哈希的目标 PBKDF2 迭代次数，以及存量凭据是否需要重哈希。

remarks

This class depends on neither System.Web nor the Web configuration resolver: Web startup injects the current configured value through ConfigureTargetProvider, and missing or failing injection always falls back to the hard lower bound MinimumIterationCount (600000), so hashing strength only increases and sign-in is never affected by configuration faults.

本类不依赖 System.Web，也不反向依赖 Web 配置读取器：Web 启动期通过 ConfigureTargetProvider 注入当前配置值，未注入或注入失败一律回落到硬下限 MinimumIterationCount（600000），确保哈希强度只增不减，且登录流程不受配置故障影响。

PortalWorkItemCompletionRequest

dotnet-type

Mutable cross-layer parameters used to update the work-item state for a business object.

Mutable cross-layer parameters used to update the work-item state for a business object.fallback: en

Localized Fields

summary

Mutable cross-layer parameters used to update the work-item state for a business object.

remarks

This request only carries a work-item handling assertion. It neither changes the business object's own state nor validates state transitions, event types, identity, or authorization. EmployeeProfileCorrectionWriteBackPolicy

dotnet-type

Pure-function policy for employee-profile correction write-back: it decides whether a field can be applied automatically and maps the proposed value onto an employee save request.

Pure-function policy for employee-profile correction write-back: it decides whether a field can be applied automatically and maps the proposed value onto an employee save request.fallback: en

Localized Fields

summary

Pure-function policy for employee-profile correction write-back: it decides whether a field can be applied automatically and maps the proposed value onto an employee save request.

员工资料更正回写的纯函数策略：判定字段是否可自动回写，并把建议值映射到员工保存请求。

remarks

This policy touches no database and depends on no session or permission; it only judges field names and maps values, so unit tests can cover it completely. Design points: (1) field names must be re-validated server-side and caller-supplied values are not trusted; (2) only low-sensitivity fields that map directly ontomay be applied automatically; (3) fields that need extra resolution and could cause a wrong assignment must be explicitly marked as requiring manual handling, so approval never silently fails to take effect.

本策略不访问数据库、不依赖会话或权限，只做字段名与值的判定与映射，因此可被单测完整覆盖。设计要点：① 字段名必须由服务端二次校验，不信任调用方传入值；② 只有能直接映射到的低敏字段才允许自动回写；③ 需要另行解析且可能造成错误指派的字段必须显式标记为"需人工处理"，避免"审核通过但未生效"的静默失败。

Source

Defined in src/Portal.Components/bin/Debug/Portal.Components.xml:1

PortalOrganizationTreeExpander

dotnet-type

Pure-function subtree expander for the organization adjacency list; it touches no database and depends on no session or permission.

Pure-function subtree expander for the organization adjacency list; it touches no database and depends on no session or permission.fallback: en

Localized Fields

summary

Pure-function subtree expander for the organization adjacency list; it touches no database and depends on no session or permission.

组织邻接表的纯函数子树展开器，不访问数据库、不依赖会话或权限。

remarks

Expansion is a pure function so that the security-relevant "organization scope" semantics can be unit tested without a database; the data layer still owns retrieval, inactive filtering, and failure handling. Expansion is breadth-first with both a depth cap and a visited set, so a malformed cycle cannot cause unbounded recursion even if the write-side cycle guard were bypassed.

把展开做成纯函数是为了让"组织范围"这一安全相关语义可以在没有数据库的环境中被单测覆盖；数据层仍然负责取数、停用过滤与失败处理。展开按广度优先进行，并用深度上限与"已访问"集合双重保护，即使写入侧的防环被绕过也不会无限递归。

Source

PortalWorkItemQueryResult

dotnet-type

Read-only result of a work-item query that distinguishes "zero rows found" from "read failure".

Read-only result of a work-item query that distinguishes "zero rows found" from "read failure".fallback: en

Localized Fields

summary

Read-only result of a work-item query that distinguishes "zero rows found" from "read failure".

待办查询的只读结果，用于区分"查到零条"与"读取失败"。

remarks

The established work-item read contracts return an empty list both for unavailable schema and for query failures, so an empty result cannot distinguish "no data" from "read failure". This type pairs a success flag with the projection list so a front end can render empty and failure states separately without exposing exception details to the user. The list itself remains a mutable point-in-time projection and does not automatically reflect concurrent updates.

既有待办读取契约把架构缺失与查询异常统一返回空列表，因此空列表无法区分"没有数据"和"读取失败"。本类型把成功标记与投影列表放在一起，使前台能够分别呈现空态与失败态，而不必把异常细节暴露给用户。列表本身仍是可变的时间点投影，不自动反映并发更新。

Source

IPortalModuleTargetSource

dotnet-type

Minimal data port required by work-item target resolution: it exposes only the six operations the reverse lookup actually uses.

Minimal data port required by work-item target resolution: it exposes only the six operations the reverse lookup actually uses.fallback: en

Localized Fields

summary

Minimal data port required by work-item target resolution: it exposes only the six operations the reverse lookup actually uses.

待办目标解析所需的最小数据端口：只暴露反查链路真正用到的六个操作。

remarks

The existing facades (module definitions, module instances, tabs) carry many members, so depending on them directly would force callers and tests to implement a large amount of unrelated surface. Following interface segregation, this port declares only the minimum the reverse lookup needs, letting the resolution logic be fully verified without touching HTTP context, database, or file system; implementations still reuse the existing facades and add no data access.

既有数据门面（模块定义、模块实例、页签）成员众多，直接依赖它们会迫使调用方与测试实现大量无关成员。本端口按接口隔离原则只声明反查所需的最小面，使解析逻辑可在不接触 HTTP 上下文、数据库与文件系统的前提下被完整验证；实现方仍复用既有门面，不新增数据访问。

Source

PortalWorkItemTargetResolver

dotnet-type

Resolves a work item's business kind into the hosting tab that the ordinary user may access in the current request.

Resolves a work item's business kind into the hosting tab that the ordinary user may access in the current request.fallback: en

Localized Fields

summary

Resolves a work item's business kind into the hosting tab that the ordinary user may access in the current request.

把待办的业务类型反查为普通用户在**当次请求**下有权限访问的承载页签。

remarks

Reverse lookup chain: business kind to capability key to primary module package to validated desktop entry to module definition to module instance to hosting tab to a role check. Every link may fail because the deployment has not mounted the module, the registration is missing, or the current user lacks access, so each link returns its own reason code instead of throwing or guessing a URL; only a fully passing chain yields a navigable target. No privilege is widened: resolution reads existing registration and role facts, grants nothing, and rewrites no module or tab configuration.

反查链：业务类型 → 能力键 → 主责模块包 → 已验证桌面入口 → 模块定义 → 模块实例 → 承载页签 → **角色检查**。链路每一环都可能是"部署未挂载""注册缺失"或"当前用户无权"，因此每一环都返回独立原因码而不是抛错或猜测地址；只有全链通过才产出可导航目标。**不扩权**：解析只读取既有注册与角色事实，不授予任何权限，也不改写模块或页签配置。

Source

remarks

Multi-instance selection (decision D1 from P77.2): among hosting tabs that **pass the role check**, take the smallest; a nullcounts as largest (sorted after those with a value), and ties keep enumeration order so the result is reproducible. Defined in src/Portal.Components/bin/Debug/Portal.Components.xml:1

PortalSecurity

dotnet-type

Provides legacy Portal role checks, module-edit decisions, and a historical password-digest helper.

Provides legacy Portal role checks, module-edit decisions, and a historical password-digest helper.fallback: en

Localized Fields

summary

Provides legacy Portal role checks, module-edit decisions, and a historical password-digest helper.

提供旧门户的角色检查、模块编辑判定和历史密码摘要辅助方法。

remarks

Module editing requires both parent-tab access roles and module edit roles.uses unsalted MD5 and remains only for existing user-data compatibility; new password systems must not use it, and a later migration must support gradual strong-hash updates after legacy-digest verification. Internal deferred-item registration (four-way split: **a real work item outside the actionable range**) — basis: this project's new password system already uses PBKDF2 (see `PortalPasswordHasher`); this entry concerns the gradual upgrade of **existing MD5-digest accounts**, which is a data migration rather than something a comment can close, so it is not remediated in this cycle. Owner: the password-system workstream (entry point in the next cycle). Re-entry conditions — start when any applies: 1) legacy-digest accounts must be rehashed automatically at sign-in; 2) the MD5 compatibility surface is required to shrink or retire; 3) a security review lists unsalted MD5 as a must-fix. On re-entry, first produce a read-only inventory (count of MD5 accounts, sign-in success rate) before deciding migration batches; never rewrite without that inventory.

模块编辑必须同时满足父 Tab 的访问角色与模块的编辑角色。使用无盐 MD5， 仅为既有用户数据兼容保留；新密码体系不得采用该方法，后续迁移需支持旧摘要验证后的渐进强哈希更新。 内部延期项登记（四分法：**可实治范围之外的真实待办**）——判定依据：本项目新密码体系已改用 PBKDF2（见 `PortalPasswordHasher`），本条指的是**存量 MD5 摘要账号**的渐进升级，属数据迁移而非注释可闭合项，故不在本周期实治。 所有者：密码体系专题（下一 Cycle 入口）。再入条件：出现任一即启动 —— ① 需要支持旧摘要账号登录时自动 rehash；② MD5 兼容面被要求收敛或下线；③ 安全评审把无盐 MD5 列为必须处置项。再入时须先出只读盘点（存量 MD5 账号数、登录成功率），再定迁移批次，禁止无盘点直接改写。

Source

remarks

This interface is used for legacy user table projections, administration user management, and login helper flows. The `Password` field is a historical storage field and must not be treated as a plain-text password or echoed in UI by new code; authentication, hash upgrades, and session invalidation are handled by dedicated services.

该接口用于旧用户表投影、后台用户管理和登录辅助流程。`Password` 字段是历史存储字段， 不能在新代码中作为明文口令或 UI 回显值使用；认证、哈希升级和会话失效由专门服务处理。

Source
